description: Get a CMS validated-run (good-run) list, which certifies the luminosity sections that are good for physics in each run. Select it by a CMS collision dataset recid, a validated-run list recid, or a run period such as Run2012B (give exactly one of recid and run_period). Choose the full validation or the muons-only variant, and narrow to a run range; a dataset recid defaults the range to the first and last run the dataset lists. Returns the runs with their luminosity-section ranges and the list file download URL. CMS only.

recid.description: A CMS collision dataset recid (its linked list is used) or a validated-run list recid (used as named): up to 12 digits, optionally after an experiment prefix (cms-93956); recid:N or a portal record URL also work. Give this or run_period.

run_max.description: Highest run to return, inclusive. Defaults with run_min for a dataset recid.

run_min.description: Lowest run to return, inclusive. With a dataset recid and neither bound set, run_min and run_max default to the first and last run the dataset lists; run_bounds echoes the range applied.

run_period.description: A CMS run period such as Run2012B, matched case-insensitively; 2012B also matches Run2012B. Give this or recid. cern_opendata_list_reference with topic run_periods lists them.

variant.description: full (every detector certified) or muons_only (certified for muon physics). Omitted: a list recid is used as named; a dataset recid or run_period selects full.

name: cern_opendata_get_validated_runs

cap.description: The page size (limit) applied to this call.

dataset.description: The dataset, when recid named a dataset rather than a list.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_selector`: Neither recid nor run_period was given. `conflicting_selectors`: Both recid and run_period were given. `invalid_range`: run_min is above run_max. `record_not_found`: recid is not a validated-run list and no record has it. `no_validated_runs`: No list matches: the record links none (a simulated, non-CMS or non-collision record; or CMS collision data whose run period no published list covers, or which links none although the collection holds a list for its period), the run period has no list, or the variant has no list for it. The message names which case applied. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false). Also raised when a search answers 404, and when a list file the collection names answers 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

list.description: The selected list, when exactly one matched.

collision_energy.description: Collision energy, when the list states it.

file_key.description: File key of the good-run list JSON.

https_url.description: HTTPS download URL of the whole list file (JSON).

portal_url.description: The list record page on the portal.

recid.description: Recid of the selected list record.

xrootd_uri.description: XRootD URI of the list file, when listed.

matched_lists.description: Every list the selector matched in the requested variant. Several means none was read: call again with recid set to one of them.

items.description: One validated-run list the selector matched.

collision_energy.description: Collision energy, when the list states it.

recid.description: Recid of the validated-run list record.

run_periods.description: Run periods the list covers, such as Run2012B.

title.description: List title; names the reconstruction pass and certification file.

variant.description: full: every detector certified; muons_only: certified for muon physics only.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: how to page on, why nothing matched and what to change, or a caveat about the results.

run_bounds.description: The run range runs was filtered to; absent when no bound applies.

run_max.description: Highest run returned, inclusive; absent when unset.

run_min.description: Lowest run returned, inclusive; absent when unset.

source.description: input: run_min/run_max as given. dataset: both defaulted to the first and last run the dataset lists.

runs.description: Certified runs, ascending, inside run_bounds and cut at limit; empty when no single list was selected.

lumi_sections.description: Luminosity sections certified good in this run.

shown.description: Number of items returned on this page.

summary.description: The whole selected list, before run_bounds.

lumi_section_count.description: Luminosity sections in the whole list.

totalCount.description: Runs in the selected list inside run_bounds.

truncated.description: True when more results remain past this page; notice says how to reach them.

title: Get CMS Validated Runs
